name: War Inc: Rising Progression Guide — Level 1 to Endgame
title: War Inc: Rising Progression Guide — Week-by-Week Roadmap to Endgame | War Inc: Rising Wiki
meta_description: Complete War Inc: Rising progression guide. Week-by-week roadmap from level 1 through endgame, covering building priority, mythic targets per stage, forge stone strategy, and what to focus on at each phase.
author: War Inc Wiki Team
excerpt: A week-by-week progression roadmap covering your first week through month 3 and beyond. Includes building priority, what mythics to target at each stage, forge stone strategy, and the common mistakes that slow down your progress.

sections.heading: Week 1-2: Building Your Foundation
sections.content:
Your first two weeks are about setting up your account for long-term success. Focus on these priorities.

Castle upgrades are your number one goal. Spend every piece of wood on upgrading the Command Center. Each level gives +50 troop energy — roughly the equivalent of 10 dragons' worth of power. Do not let wood sit idle.

Complete all daily quests every day. You get 5 quests per day with 3 resets. Use your resets to avoid quests that require troops you do not have. Do not forget weekly and seasonal quests.

Save your gems. Do not spend a single gem in the first two weeks. Let your gem stash build for the Wheel when good mythic rotations appear.

Start building your core roster. Work toward getting Oracles (the best epic in the game, buy them whenever available) and 8-10 level 6 Poison Masters. These two units will carry you through the early and mid game.

Collect free resources daily. Free items from the shop, event rewards, and daily sign-in rewards all add up.

sections.heading: Week 3-4: Transition to Mid Game
sections.content:
By week 3-4, you should have a solid foundation and be ready to start investing your resources.

Start using gems on the Wheel. Look for good mythic rotations featuring Radiant Warrior, Frost Queen, or Bone Marksman. Stop at milestone chests (10, 30, 50, 100 pulls) to keep your cost per mythic efficient.

Build Bombs through fusion. Fuse 3 level 6 uncommon troops together using gold. This gives you a chance at Bombs, which dominate the 2,500-5,000 trophy range in Arena.

Join an active clan. Look for clans on the official Discord. Active clans provide Clan War rewards, coordination, and advice from experienced players.

Start Co-Op grinding. Learn the mine-first strategy. Keep your gold mine at level 5. Use gold for dice rolling. Coordinate card picks with your partner.

sections.heading: Month 2: Mythic Acquisition
sections.content:
Month 2 is about building your mythic roster. Target these specific mythics in order.

First priority: Radiant Warrior. Get two copies and keep them at the same level. Never merge your last two.

Second priority: Frost Queen. Same rule — keep two copies at the same level. Her AoE damage dominates PvP.

Third priority: Bone Marksman. Level 4 minimum. His skill unlocks early making him a pseudo level-6.

Fourth priority: Light Seeker and Necromancer. Light Seeker for PvP, Necromancer for PvE. Get both if you can.

Push to 2,500-5,000 trophies in Arena. This is the sweet spot where Bombs dominate. Participate in Clan War to learn the basics. Join Dragon Clash events when they run.

Continue upgrading your castle. It should be your highest-level building at all times.

sections.heading: Month 3+: Late Game Optimization
sections.content:
By month 3, you should have a solid roster and be competing at higher levels.

Level 7 your best legendaries. Ursa and Elven Archer to level 7 with forge stones. These are the best legendary investments.

Level 8+ your best epics. Focus on Oracles, Flame Mages, and Poison Masters. The cost for a level 8 epic from rares is roughly 576 forge stones.

Consider level 9 rares. Forest Scouts, Shove Boy, and Bombs are worth taking to level 9. The cost from level 6 is roughly 1,056 forge stones.

Enter the Ruler system for Clan War. Get your core stone to level 6-7 before spending fragments. The 50% success rate on upgrades means you need to be strategic.

Build multiple S-tier mythics to level 4 or higher. Having 3-4 top-tier mythics gives you flexibility across all game modes. Aim for top 1,000 in Arena.

sections.heading: Building Priority at Every Stage
sections.content:
Your building priority stays consistent throughout the game, but the emphasis changes.

Castle (Command Center) is always the top priority. Every level gives +50 troop energy. This never stops being important.

Spell Cauldron becomes relevant at mid game when you have enough troops to benefit from spells. Unlocks at specific castle levels.

Gold Mine should reach level 5 early and stay there. The passive gold income supports your fusion and recruitment.

Sawmill is only worth upgrading enough to keep castle construction going. Do not overspend on it.

Follower Camp is lowest priority. Leave it at level 1 until everything else is maxed.

Daily building routine: collect everything, start next castle upgrade, then queue other buildings. Castle first, always.

sections.heading: Forge Stone Strategy by Stage
sections.content:
Forge stones become the most scarce resource from mid game onward. Spend them wisely.

Early game: Do not spend any forge stones yet. Save them. Maybe upgrade one common to level 7 for the 100-gem Power Stance achievement.

Mid game: Start investing in Ursa and Elven Archer. Get them to level 7. These give the best return on forge stone investment.

Late game: Level 8+ your core epics (Oracles, Flame Mages, Poison Masters). Consider level 9 rares for Forest Scouts and Shove Boy.

Never waste forge stones on: Fury Cannoneer, Blast Dwarf, Wood Shield Guard, or any troop you will replace soon. Watch for forge stone discount events (15% off level 7+ upgrades) and time your big upgrades accordingly.

sections.heading: Common Mistakes That Slow Progression
sections.content:
These mistakes are the most common reasons players hit walls or waste weeks of progress.

Wasting forge stones on wrong troops is the most expensive mistake. Ursa and Elven Archer first, then Oracles and Flame Mages. Never on commons or bad mythics.

Merging your last two copies of a strong troop. Keep two Radiant Warriors. Keep two Frost Queens. Two level 3s are better than one level 4 until you have a third copy.

Spending gems on extra battles, fusion, or speed-ups. Gems are for the Wheel and Card Master only.

Using wood on non-castle buildings. Every piece of wood should go to the castle until it is maxed.

Not joining a clan. Clan War rewards accelerate your progression significantly.

Not using the free Trial feature in Clan War. Testing formations costs zero morale and gives you valuable data.

mainEntity.name: What should I focus on in my first week of War Inc: Rising?

acceptedAnswer.text: Focus on castle upgrades, complete all daily quests, save your gems, and start collecting Oracles and Poison Masters.

mainEntity.name: When should I start spending gems in War Inc: Rising?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start spending gems on the Wheel in week 3-4, when good mythic rotations appear. Stop at milestone chests (10, 30, 50, 100 pulls).

mainEntity.name: What is the best building to upgrade first?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Castle (Command Center) is always the top priority. Each level gives +50 troop energy. Spend all wood on castle upgrades.

mainEntity.name: What mythics should I target at month 2?

acceptedAnswer.text: Target Radiant Warrior (first), Frost Queen (second), Bone Marksman (third), then Light Seeker and Necromancer.

mainEntity.name: What is the worst mistake new players make?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wasting forge stones on the wrong troops and merging their last two copies of strong troops like Radiant Warrior and Frost Queen.
